question: Is the per-gradient drop from posteriordb v6 to v7 (oWALNUTS / CmdStan min-bulk-ESS per gradient over the fixed 16: 0.848 -> 0.708) caused by the WP52 Init::best_of(16) start default?
worktree: wt/posteriordb-v7 at the WP56 head, whose src/, integrations/, tests/ and Cargo.toml equal f097391c (checked by the driver before every run)

arms.uniform: Sampler::new() with only warmup 1000, draws 1000, chains 4, seed, threads 4 and Limits::new().admit_worst_case(); starts Init::uniform() (Stan's uniform(-2,2), up to 100 draws per chain)
arms.best_of_16: identical, starts Init::best_of(16) (= Init::default() at f097391c; recorded per cell)

model_selection: accel_gp, one_comp and hmm_drive_0 (the largest v7 per-gradient losses against CmdStan) named by the coordinator, plus the three models with the lowest best_of_16/uniform ratio in STUDIES/init_rule_confirmation_v1/artifacts/summary.json per_model that are not already named: earnings (0.208), eight_schools_centered (0.524), kidiq (0.835). hmm_drive_0 (0.365) is the second-lowest and is already named, so the next one (kidiq) is taken to make six.
selection_bias_note: Three of six models were chosen because best_of_16 looked worst on WP52's seeds; with fresh seeds regression to the mean pulls their ratios toward 1, while the selection itself biases the geomean toward H1. Both effects are stated, neither is corrected.
models_source: BridgeStan libraries copied from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/models (themselves WP48 sibling builds)
seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over every tracked file of the worktree at the WP56 head found none of 600601-600605
run_order: models in listed order; within a model seeds ascending; within a seed uniform then best_of_16; strictly sequential; one sampling process at a time
parameter_set: posteriordb reference-draw columns (all six models have reference draws); ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05, 0.95), mean MCSE; reference z reported

statistic.cell: min over reference parameters of bulk ESS divided by gradients_total (start search, warmup and sampling target calls)
statistic.model_ratio: geometric mean over the five paired seeds of best_of_16 / uniform (equivalently the ratio of the per-arm geomeans over the paired seeds); a seed is paired only if both cells are status ok
statistic.primary: geometric mean of the six model ratios
statistic.count: number of models whose ratio is below 1.0
statistic.mechanism_telemetry: per chain: start log density (re-evaluated after the run), end-of-warmup step, warmup step trace every 50 transitions, warmup and retained gradients, per-chain min bulk ESS; per cell: chain warnings, gates, max |z|

hypotheses.H1: the start rule causes the drop: best_of_16 / uniform paired geomean < 0.9
hypotheses.H0: the start rule does not cause it (fresh seeds and the WP36 rescue removal do): paired geomean >= 0.95

decision_rule.text: If the paired geomean is < 0.9 with at least 4 of 6 model ratios below 1.0, recommend reverting the default to Init::uniform() (best_of stays opt-in). If >= 0.95, recommend keeping Init::best_of(16). Otherwise (including < 0.9 with fewer than 4 models below 1.0) report inconclusive and recommend keeping it with the number documented. This study flips nothing.
decision_rule.incomplete: A failed cell is a result and is not rerun; its seed is unpaired for that model. The rule is applied to the paired seeds available and the README states the count.

rules: No reruns, no tuning after results; failures are results. Walls are contended (shared machine) and are not evidence.
